reaction: oxidative carbocyclisation followed by C-C bond cleavage in one active site, building the Delta3-pyrroline ring of Aeap with the loss of three carbon atoms
source: GenBank BAZ23339.1 (locus NIES4073_42270, 717 aa, AP018268.1:4547309..4549462 complement), Kalymmatonema gypsitolerans NIES-4073, published as Scytonema sp. NIES-4073; characterised as ScAerC by Zhang W, Ushimaru R, Kanaida M, Abe I, J Am Chem Soc 2025;147:10853-10858, doi:10.1021/jacs.5c01994
notes: First C-C bond cleavage reference in this set. AerC performs oxidative carbocyclisation and then cleaves a C-C bond in one active site, building the Delta3-pyrroline ring of Aeap with the loss of three carbon atoms; the authors call it a unique route to heterocycle formation. reaction_class records the cleavage because that is the chemistry the set lacked, but the enzyme also forms a C-C bond: reaction_class holds one value per type, which is a limit of the schema and not of the enzyme. IDENTIFICATION. The paper names the enzyme ScAerC from Scytonema sp. NIES-4073 but gives no accession, and the survey first rejected it for that reason. The organism has since been renamed Kalymmatonema gypsitolerans NIES-4073, so searching the published name finds nothing. None of the 12 Rieske proteins in that genome is annotated as a Rieske oxygenase; this one is annotated 'putative oxidoreductase'. It was identified by length against the Nodularia sphaerocarpa orthologue ULP74381.1 (720 aa, SuoC) and confirmed by genomic context: its immediate neighbour at 4,547,312 is an isopentenyl-diphosphate delta-isomerase, and the region carries NRPS genes and a BacA homologue, which is the signature of the Aeap cluster because Aer3 needs DMAPP. DO NOT CONFUSE with CAD5975418 (366 aa, Planktothrix agardhii), which is also called AerC and FAILS the Rieske motif; it is a different protein. LIGANDS verified in-column by fragment alignment, because a global alignment of a 717 aa protein to the catalytic-centre model covers only 18.9 % and never reaches the catalytic columns, which produced a false 0/3. Rieske C146, H148, C168, H171; bridging D511; mononuclear H513, H518. hmmsearch full length E = 3.8e-68 over three domains, and the orthologue gives identical ligands. CARBOXYLATE POSITION UNKNOWN. It is present on biochemical grounds, since the paper measures 3.00 +/- 0.02 Fe and 2.2 +/- 0.2 S per monomer, that is 2 Fe of the Rieske cluster plus one mononuclear Fe, and the nearest relatives carry it (RedG D327, bfzA E418). Its residue could not be located: the model region holding that column has no counterpart here. The column test therefore scores 2/3, which is a statement about the alignment and not about the protein. Roadmap item 68; full evidence in analysis_out/aerc_resolution.json. substrate_smiles and a product SMILES are left EMPTY on purpose: no SMILES for N4-isopentenylagmatine or Aeap was verified, and a wrong one is worse than a missing one.
